svg.title: The OpenGCUA open stack
svg.desc: Model: a GCUA model for both computer use and browser use, next. Agent design: the OpenGCUA harness for OSWorld-v2 with code execution and harness-to-model decision transfer, released. Real device: the macOS real-device harness, a menu-bar app, and the Cross-Device SDK, both preliminary. Trajectory: execution trajectories of 8 frontier models including GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash, released. Efficiency: execution efficiency through code execution, thinking length, harness design, and system-level improvements, next. Evaluation: real-device environments and a benchmark, next.
